sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Arrived at Aotea Square; completed welfare checks on Starbucks till Yoyoso. No issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
The library area and Lorne St is all clear; heading through High St.
High St all clear. Heading to Chancery Square via O'Connell St.
Freyberg Square and Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from V-Fix mobile store requesting assistance with removing a POI that is refusing to leave.

Arrived on site; Council Wardens were there but couldn't do anything since it's on private property. She had left before we arrived and we got the statement from the store worker. An Asian female came in to fix her phone, and when she handed the phone to the worker it came apart as he inspected the screen. The worker said he'll be able to fix it at the rate given, but she tried to put the blame on the worker. We requested CCTV from the worker and were given the number. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Tatty's Recycle Boutique regarding a female who attempted to steal but was apprehended by the store worker. They wanted to give us a heads up and will send the picture to us.
Heading towards Wyndham St via Federal St.
Federal St all clear and Cathedral area all clear too. Welfare checks completed at the following stores (standing by at the corner intersection of Albert and Wyndham St):
Welfare check on Chemist Warehouse. All clear. We also received a call from a guard needing access into the HQ building.
Arrived at the office; multiple police cruisers near the Library — we will be making our way there.
Arrived at the scene; the Library has been evacuated. Police aren't giving any information. Standing by for added security presence.
Heading towards Darby and Elliot St.
Elliot and Darby St all clear; continuing patrols down towards Commercial Bay. Will be conducting welfare checks on businesses.
Arrived at the bottom of Commercial Bay; welfare checks conducted on all businesses from Mecca and Farmer down to Q Convenience. All clear, no issues to report. Continuing with patrols.
Britomart McDonald's and Commercial Bay is all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.

Heading back to the office via Fort and High St.

Heading to check on the surrounding businesses.

Aotea Square full sweep all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from McDonald's Queen St in regards to a female sleeping in the business; heading to assist.
We removed the POI and standing by for security presence.
Received a call from manager asking for assistance with entering HQ.
Let a manager up in HQ and taking our break.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St; welfare checks completed (standing by for security presence):
Heading towards Elliot and Darby St via Federal and Wellesley St.
Federal, Wellesley, Elliot Stable, Pizza Club, Domino's, Celine, Elliot and Darby St is all clear. Heading to the office to charge Ops Phone.
Standing by at office to charge Ops Phone which is at 20%.
Continuing to charge the Ops phone and standing by to do shift changeover.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:00 – 06:30)
items: Welfare checks completed at the following (patrolling up to Aotea to commence full sweep):
Arrived at Aotea Square commencing full sweep; was approached by a member of the public regarding a male individual harassing others, so will be standing by showing our presence to minimise risk.
Full sweep Aotea Square; stand down standby. Continuing patrols down to Mayoral Drive.
Sweep Mayoral Drive check; all clear, no issues identified. Heading down to Elliot St to commence and welfare-check Bar101.
Arrived at Elliot St; commencing sweep and welfare checks.
Full sweep Elliot St / Darby St; welfare check Bar101 and all businesses open at this time. All clear, no issues to report. Heading back to headquarters, standing by till 3rd guard arrives.
3rd guard has arrived at headquarters; standing by in office to commence floor check and debrief.
Floor checks completed. Commencing patrols lower Queen Street.
Full sweep lower Queen Street, Shortland St, bottom of High Street; welfare check 77 Convenience Store. All clear, no issues to report. Patrolling to Sapphire Nightclub.
Sweep in Fort Lane, Fort St; welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, Jo&Joes, The Right Track. All clear, no issues to report. Heading to Britomart to commence sweep.
Arrived at Britomart commencing sweep; a lot of foot traffic seen in the area, so will be standing by for 15 minutes then continuing patrols.
Removed alcohol from a group of male delinquents drinking in public. All clear, no issues to report.

A member of the public encountered us saying a male intoxicated individual is harassing her, and requested that we stay with her till her Uber arrives to take her home; we will be standing by till her transport arrives.
Female individual that was being harassed has been escorted to her transportation safely.
Full sweep Britomart; welfare check McDonald's. All clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Kemuri and Reign N Pour. All clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Quay Street to commence sweep around the area and welfare-check on the guards.
Quay Street full sweep. All clear, no issues to report. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Full sweep bottom half of Albert Street. All clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Ace Nightclub. All clear, no issues to report. Commencing sweep up St Patricks Square.
Full sweep St Patricks Cathedral, Liston House, Federal Square. All clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear, no issues.
Sweep Victoria Street West; welfare check 77Convenience Store. All clear, no issues to report. Patrolling down Albert to Aotea Square to commence sweep.
Sweep top half of Albert Street; welfare check Albert Mart. All clear, no issues.
Sweep Mayoral Drive; all clear, no issues. Arriving at Aotea commencing sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square; no issues to report. Heading down towards Bar101 till closing.
Received a text message from Shakes on Vulcan Lane regarding their alarm going off; already notified that we will be including it in our patrols.
Welfare check Bar101. All clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrols.
Sweep Darby St / Elliot St. All clear, no further issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Sweep Victoria Street West; welfare check 77Convenience Store. No further issues.
Full sweep Federal St; check-in St Patrick's Cathedral church, Liston House. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St. All clear, no issues. Heading down Queen Street to Britomart.
Welfare check Shakes. All clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay. All clear, no issues.
Completed check Fort St / Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues. Patrolling up High Street to Freyberg for full sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square. All clear, no issues.
Sweeped corner of Lorne St / Wakefield. All clear, no issues. Patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Full sweep Aotea Square. All clear, no issues to report; no foot traffic in the area. Heading down Queen Street to welfare-check.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's. All clear, no issues to report. Heading to HQ to commence 30-minute break and wait till morning shift handover.
Arrived at headquarters; commencing break and responding to any calls that occur.
Night shift has been concluded; handing over to morning shift.
